summary.placeVerdict: All 13 catalog/placeAnchor areas resolve to Kandarin for League purposes. Warforge is geographic Feldip Hills but wiki Equilibrium League badges mark Warforge excavation as Kandarin. Barbarian Outpost is explicitly Kandarin on wiki despite Fremennik border adjacency.
summary.fremennikBleed: No catalog area is Fremennik. Risk is name-confusion (Barbarian Outpost / Otto / Ancient Cavern) and foreign upgrade rows (Deathless/Koschei, pickaxe chains) sitting under regionId kandarin.
summary.asgarniaBleed: No catalog area is Asgarnia. White Wolf Mountain is the eastern border; Catherby stays Kandarin. Stormguard entrance is Temple of Ikov (Hemenster/Kandarin) — do not refile Ancient Invention as Asgarnia. Foreign hard-Asgarnia upgrades (wicked hood, Entrana hops, botanist mask) are incorrectly parked under Kandarin.
summary.tirannwnBleed: The Lost Grove is Tirannwn (western sea / fairy BJS), not Kandarin Piscatoris (AKQ). Tirannwn-hard upgrades (Crwys, Ithell, Morvran, crystal seed/skillchompas) are incorrectly parked under Kandarin.

proposedHardRules: Treat Barbarian Outpost, Otto's Grotto, the Ancient Cavern and Kuradal as Kandarin. Do not refile them under Fremennik because of barbarian naming.
Treat Warforge Dig Site and Monastery of Ascension (Feldip Hills geography) as Kandarin League content per wiki League badges. Do not map them to Karamja.
Treat Stormguard Citadel Dig Site / Howl's Floating Workshop / Ancient Invention as Kandarin via the Temple of Ikov entrance. Do not map them to Asgarnia.
Do not list The Lost Grove under Kandarin; it is Tirannwn. Piscatoris / Memorial to Guthix / Hall of Memories remain Kandarin.
proposedWarnings: data/league/regions.json currently lists only three Kandarin areas (POF, Hall of Memories, DSF hub) while catalog/placeAnchors carry thirteen — product surface is under-described.

Kandarin upgrades bag includes 22 rows whose requiredRegions omit Kandarin entirely (Fremennik/Asgarnia/Tirannwn/Anachronia/Desert/Forinthry/Karamja/Misthalin/Morytania masters and tools). These inflate nUpgrades=130 and should be rehomed or tagged cross-region.
Fairy ring directory labels DKS/AJR as Kandarin while those destinations are Fremennik Province — inverse bleed; do not import them as Kandarin places.
